title: Multi-field ordering silently sorts by the wrong field when using QueryArrayWidget (value order not preserved)
author: juneja-varun
body_preview: ## The issue  If you use `QueryArrayWidget` as the widget for a multi-value filter where **order matters** — most notably `OrderingFilter`, which supports multi-field sorting via `qs.order_by(*ordering)` — the order you submit values in isn't preserved. `?ordering[]=price&ordering[]=-name` (sort by price, then by name descending as a tiebreaker) can silently come back sorted as `-name,price` inste...
